name: Myth Dug Up
footer:
Myth Dug Up — today's biggest stories, dug up. Every video says what is proven and what is still debated.
Illustrations painted with code (no photos), narration is synthetic.
#news #shorts
style: Current news stories (last 24-72 h). Plates in news styles: newscollage, blueprint, letterpress, notebook, bauhaus, ballpoint; maps/charts via kit; paper cut-outs and stamps PROVEN / DEBATED / ALLEGED.
